plQuality.title: Quality inspections
plQuality.subtitle: Nothing moulded or assembled moves to stock or dispatch until it is cleared here
plQuality.emptyBody: Good pieces from a shift entry or an assembly order appear here until someone inspects them.

accept.title: Accept:
accept.body: accepted pieces move from quarantine to stock and become available.

reject.title: Reject:
reject.body: the whole quantity goes to the rejection bucket; production sees it.

hold.title: Hold:
hold.body: the inspection is recorded and the lot stays in quarantine.

who.title: Who inspects:
who.body: never the operator, the person who recorded the shift, or the assembler.

plQuality.lotHidden: This lot can't be read with your rights.
plQuality.youMadeIt: You made or recorded this lot, so the server will refuse your inspection; someone else must inspect it.
plQuality.rule: Final and assembly inspections decide the whole lot: accepted + rejected must equal the quantity in quarantine.
plQuality.noRight: Inspections need the QC right (final and assembly: the QC release right). Ask Admin.
plQuality.saved: Inspection of {{doc}} recorded. Lot is now: {{status}}.
